answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ember. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
